headline: A 40-kilometer queue. 990 trucks stuck at the Uzbekistan–Kazakhstan border
summary: A queue of 990 cargo trucks has formed at the Uzbek-Kazakh border in Turkestan region, stretching about 40 km, according to drivers.
why: Border crossings on Central Asian trade routes carry freight between neighbouring markets, so long delays raise logistics costs and slow the movement of goods.
original_headline: Очередь на 40 километров. На границе Узбекистана и Казахстана застряли 990 фур
